item.title: The Access Group Acquires Route Optimization Platform MaxOptra
item.description: The Access Group has acquired MaxOptra, a London-based route Optimization and delivery management platform used by more than 450 customers to optimise over 6,000 vehicles daily across 26 industry sectors, including food and beverage, construction, logistics, and waste management.
